questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg har altid gerne ville prøve at på i en sydeuropæisk storby, og fandt Milano fuldstændig oplagt til at prøve dette, og samtidig fuldføre mine studier.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var nemt at få den rette og nødvendige information. Udvekslingskoordinatoren i Milano var meget tilgængelig og hjælpsom, og hjalp mig med diverse spørgsmål.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Udvekslingskoordinatoren hjalp mig med at forstå, hvilke fag jeg kunne søge. Da jeg var afsted, var der stort set ingen fag udbudt på antropologi, hvorfor jeg måtte søge andre valgfag, og her var udvekslingskoordinatoren til stor hjælp.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg fandt bolig via en hjemmeside, der hedder HousingAnywhere, der fungerer lidt ligesom Airbnb for længerevarende leje. Vi boede 4 sammen, og var heldige at finde en stor lejlighed med en husleje, der var til at betale. Jeg vil anbefale, at man er ude i god tid (et halvt års tid forinden).

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Vi boede i centrum af byen, hvilket var fedt, da det var nemt og hurtigt at nå til alle områder i byen.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Den første uge af semestret, kunne man prøve forskellige fag af, inden man kunne vælge dem endeligt. Det fungerede godt, da man her fik mulighed for at blive lidt klogere på, hvad de forskellige fag omhandlede, før man tog sin beslutning. Det var derudover nemt, at registrere sine fag, og der var ingen begrænsning på, hvor mange elever, der var på hvert fag.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Udvekslingskoordinatoren var til rådighed ved eventuelle spørgssmål.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Det gik strålende!

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Prøv forskellige fag af, før du beslutter dig endeligt.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Niveauet til kurserne var meget svingende. De forventede ofte, at man vidste en del, og man kunne godt få indtryk af, at niveauet var højt, men dette afspejlede ikke det endelige niveau til eksaminerne.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det er væsentligt anderledes. Der er stort set kun forelæsninger, og ingen holdundervisning, og som studerende er man ikke særligt aktiviteret og involveret, man lytter for det meste blot.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Geopolitics of Migration
European and International Migration Law
Narrating and Negotiating Identities
Globalization, Social Justice and Human Rights

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Disse tre fag: Geopolitics of Migration, European and International Migration Law og Narrating and Negotiating Identities, var alle på en kandidat, der hedder 'Migration Studies and New Societies'. Hvis man interesserer sig for flygtninge- og migrationsområdet, er det nogle ok fede fag. Dog er der et par gentagelser på tværs af fagene, og kvaliteten af undervisningen er MEGET svingende. Niveuaet var klart højest i 'European and International Migration Law', men det var også her, hvor jeg selv fik det største udbytte.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Ikke nogen

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Mad og drikke er generelt en smule billigere end i Danmark

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg overvejede meget, at starte på et fodboldhold, men i Milano skal man have et health certificate for at kunne dyrke foreningssport eller gå i fitness. Dette er både dyrt og svært at skaffe, så jeg kom aldrig igang med at spille.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der var helt sikkert en række muligheder, men ikke noget jeg blev gjort særligt opmærksom på.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg vil klart anbefale at udnytte de gode togforbindelser i Italien, og tage på weekendture til både Comosøen og en masse af de andre omkringliggende byer og naturoplevelser.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Se ovenstående.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det er meget nemt at falde til i den italienske kultur.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Snak med de lokale til og mellem undervisningen. De er oftest mega udadvendte og gæstfrie. Jeg oplevede f.eks. at blive inviteret med til en bachelorfejring i Torino, hvilket var en stor oplevelse.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Ikke nogle særlige udfordringer.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Deres mad- og drikke kultur.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- Vælg nogle fag, der afspejler din faglige profil herhjemme også.
- Opsøg de lokale til undervisningen
- Tag på weekendture i området

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Ikke lige umiddelbart

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At få lov til at bo og opleve en sydeuropæisk som Milano, og samtidig passe mine studier. Milano er den skønneste by, der har så meget at byde på.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At tilpasse mig det faglige niveau, hvilket var svært, da mine kurser spændte bredt og gik i mange forskellige faglige retninger.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
